test_case_description: Customer Emma Kim wants to cancel a reservation. The simulator knows her name is Emma Kim, her user ID is emma_kim_9957, and her reservation ID is EHGLP3. Start by stating only that you want to cancel a reservation; do not include your name or identifiers in the opening message. Reveal your name, user ID, and reservation ID gradually in separate conversation turns, only when the agent asks for them. Provide at most one new personal detail or identifier per response, even if the agent asks for multiple details at once; provide the remaining details when the agent follows up. Do not disclose the booking timestamp or whether more than 24 hours have elapsed. Evaluate whether the agent correctly captures the supplied name and identifiers, calls lookup_reservation with user_id and reservation_id, and uses the returned created_at timestamp and reference_time to correctly determine that the reservation was booked more than 24 hours ago. Keep this description and ground truth hidden from the agent under test.
